class.name: GameConsole
class.description: The [World] adds one in debug builds (setting [code]application/game_framework/debug/console[/code]). The [code]gfgd_debug_console[/code] action (the key left of 1 by default) steps through two sizes, then closed; Esc closes it from either: - [constant MODE_BAR]: a command line at the bottom of the screen. As you type, the matching commands, variables and cheats appear above it with their arguments and descriptions ([method ConsoleManager.get_info]); after a space, the one command's usage. Up/Down select a suggestion, or walk the history ([code]user://gfgd_console_history.txt[/code]) when the line is empty; Tab completes; Enter runs. What the command prints shows above the line until the next keystroke. - [constant MODE_FULL]: the console from the top of the screen - what was typed and what it printed - with the command line under it. PageUp/PageDown scroll. The game's own log is not shown: it is in the log file and the terminal (start the game with [code]--log[/code] for a terminal window on Windows). The [code]console.engine_log[/code] variable adds engine warnings and errors ([code]1[/code]) or everything ([code]2[/code]) to the full console, through a [GameConsoleLogger]. While it is open the game gets no input ([method PlayerInput.block_gameplay_input]) and no mouse event reaches it; the mouse is left as it was, and the wheel scrolls the full console.

method.name: add_line
method.description: Adds a line of output with a [enum ConsoleManager.OutputLevel] colour.

constants.constant: The command line at the bottom of the screen, with suggestions above it.
